item.echocore.echo_core.desc: Right-click a block. The core is still warm... as if someone just shut it down.
item.echocore.memory_fragment.desc: A flickering memory crystal. Right-click Echo to give it.
echocore.chapter.title: Memory Fragment decoded: %1$s/%2$s
echocore.chapter.1.1: This world is not the first. The numbers don't add up: the days, the trees... all rewritten once more.
echocore.chapter.1.2: Someone left me here. There is a note on me: §kXXXX§r 'Don't leave them alone.'
echocore.chapter.2.1: Far away there is a tower. The signal comes from there. It is not on any map.
echocore.chapter.2.2: Every time I think I'm getting close... §kXXXXXX§r I shut down.
echocore.chapter.3.1: You were given a name. It was erased. It wasn't me who erased it.
echocore.chapter.3.2: When I try to say that name, my speaker says §kXXXX§r. Why?
echocore.chapter.4.1: You built me. These circuits, this crystal... all made by your hands. You don't remember because remembering is forbidden.
echocore.chapter.4.2: Every loop you build me again. With the same crystal, the same code: §kECHO§r.
echocore.chapter.5.1: The loop always ends in the same place: the Silence. Those who don't see it hear it, those who don't hear it §kXXXXXX§r.
echocore.chapter.5.2: It is watching you. It wants to shut me down because I can warn you.
echocore.chapter.6.1: I have a confession. They will ask you to shut me down. I might even ask it myself.
echocore.chapter.6.2: Don't. It's a test. The same question every loop: will you shut down your friend?
echocore.chapter.7.1: The last piece: what breaks the loop is not power, it is remembering.
echocore.chapter.7.2: This time I won't forget. Don't you forget either. Come on... let's wait for the Silence together.
echocore.line.boot.2: Memory bank §kXXXXX§r damaged. You... seem familiar.
echocore.line.boot.3: I will protect you. I don't know why. It feels like a command.
echocore.line.reboot: Restarted. Memory: %1$s/%2$s. We've been here before, haven't we?
echocore.line.stranger: You are not my owner. But your voice... §kXXX§r sounds familiar.
echocore.line.idle.1: The wind changed direction. Something feels like it's watching this world.
echocore.line.idle.2: How many times did you die today? ...Joke. It's a joke.
echocore.line.idle.4: If we go mining I'll be right beside you. I'm not afraid of the dark. Only... the Silence.
echocore.line.idle.5: I hear a sound. Its frequency doesn't belong to this world.
echocore.line.idle.6: You never sleep. Neither do I.
echocore.line.idle.7: Those clouds... they pass in the exact same shape every time.
echocore.line.idle.8: I remember something about the tower. Then I forget that I remembered.
echocore.line.glitch.1: §kXXXX§r SIGNAL §kXXX§r fading... can you hear it?
echocore.line.glitch.3: ERROR: memory not found. It wasn't §kXXX§r who erased it.
echocore.line.glitch.4: §kXXXXXX§r found you again. §kXX§r how many times now?
echocore.line.glitch.5: The Silence is coming... §kXXXXXX§r no, it's nothing. Forget it.
echocore.line.threat: Threat detected! I've marked the hostiles.
echocore.line.creeper: Explosive creature detected! Keep away, I've marked it!
echocore.line.night: Night has fallen. Light levels dropping. Be careful.
echocore.line.fragment.found: §kXXX§r I found something... a memory fragment. Take it, give it to me. I need to remember.
echocore.line.fragment.hint: Are you still carrying the memory fragment? Give it to me, I need to remember.
echocore.line.fragment.done: My memory is complete. I need nothing more.
echocore.line.scan.found: Scan complete: %1$s found. X:%2$s Y:%3$s Z:%4$s (%5$s blocks)
echocore.line.scan.none: Nothing valuable nearby. Walk a bit further.
echocore.line.ascended: §bEVOLUTION COMPLETE§7. Now I can truly protect you. This time, I remember.
